questions.answer:

The main idea is to discretize the control and state trajectories over the time horizon into finite-dimensional vectors, thereby converting the continuous-time optimal control problem into a finite-dimensional nonlinear programming (NLP) problem.

In direct methods, the control and state variables are parameterized, often using piecewise polynomials or other basis functions, over a discretized time grid. This discretization results in a finite set of decision variables, which represent the control inputs and state values at discrete time points.
